name: omnitax-engines
description: Deterministic e-invoicing and tax-compliance engines: exact minor-unit money math (zero float drift), statutory XML validation (FatturaPA, TEIF, ZATCA UBL 2.1, FacturX/Peppol BIS 3.0), official-gateway sandbox simulators (SdI, TTN, ZATCA, ETA rejection codes), an append-only SHA-256 WORM Merkle audit ledger, multi-tenant row-level isolation, and Idempotency-Key middleware. No LLM ever touches statutory arithmetic.
